name: datamind-context
description: One-click Codex plugin for DataMind RAG, GraphRAG, managed folders, dynamic memory, feedback-aware structured memory, and a lightweight LLM Wiki.

interface.shortDescription: RAG, GraphRAG, folders, feedback-aware memory, and Wiki
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to DataMind so local folders can be extracted into managed knowledge bases, summarized into a lightweight Markdown Wiki, high-value habits and high-value Q&A can be recorded automatically, structured memory can recall preferences and workflows, next-state feedback can be captured as reusable hints, Wiki health can be linted, and static knowledge plus dynamic memory can be queried through RAG or GraphRAG tools. Release packages can include a bundled DataMind runtime for one-click installation.
